provenance.source: Decompiled QB scripts from Data/pre/qb_scripts.prx of a clean US PC install
provenance.note: No game assets are included. Only factual data: trick names, button inputs and base scores.

knownGaps.detail: GrindTrickList appears once as data; the direction-to-family selection happens in THUG2.exe, not in any script. The nine families are certain, the direction each maps to is inferred from their contents and matches series convention.

Per-character specials are FACTORY DEFAULTS, not exclusivity. The Edit Tricks menu builds its list from the global ConfigurableTricks array filtered by TrickIsLocked, which is save-file unlock state and not character identity.

master_skater_list is what the PC scripts DEFINE, which is not proven to be what the PC build lets you PLAY. Eric Sparrow has a full profile and four specials here, but did not appear as playable after unlocking every skater in a real PC install (2026-07-19). Some entries may be unused, cut, or carried over from another edition of the game. Treat character and trick availability as unverified until tested in-game.
24 trick IDs are listed in alltricks.qb but have no definition anywhere in the game files, so they carry no name, animation or score. They appear to be cut content and are omitted.

aerialFlips.note: Whole-body rotations in the air, entered by holding a direction. Roll shows as BS or FS depending on which way you are facing. The script names the directions but not the button, so the button is left unstated here rather than guessed.

otherTricks.note: Found by sweeping the scripts for trigger constructs rather than by reading a known list. These are real, named and triggerable, but they sit outside the loadout, grind and manual tables above.

groundTricks.note: Entered from the ground rather than from a slot binding.

tricks.name: No Comply
tricks.doubleTapNote: the jump slot, entered by tapping the direction twice; Beanplant for Bam Margera, Bob Burnquist, Rodney Mullen

vehicles.note: A character riding a vehicle uses this short vocabulary instead of their skater tricks. Only the characters listed under "usedBy" ever mount one.

sharedBaseline.description: Default slot bindings identical for all 28 characters.

grinds.note: Grinds are directional but are not listed in the Edit Tricks menu. Frontside, backside and 180 variants are chosen from stance and approach angle.

manuals.note: Manuals are not in the Edit Tricks menu either. Enter with two directions, then press pairs of face buttons while balancing. Branches chain indefinitely.
